needleScan.what: every transaction's raw bytes and every contract state after each action, in every block of the arm's localnet runs, searched for each evm_k256 identity the arm's tests used: the 20-byte address (and reversed), the point's coordinates (big- and little-endian, and the circuit's limb form), the blind (and reversed), and their text forms (hex, EIP-55), each by windows at both ends; and for the keys of the other schemes the tests used. Positive controls must be found by the same search; random needles must not

deviceEntries.note: the entry recipe's control is searched under the device tag of both build generations; each account's entry is found under exactly one of them

kinds: control: jubjub device target jubjub J: its entry at (epoch 0, counter 0)
control: jubjub grantee jubjub J: its grant id (slot 0)

control: k256 grantee k256 K: its grant id (slot 0)
